sentences.text: Dated this the 10th day of February, 2025
ORDER This Bail Application is filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita.
2. Petitioner is an accused in Crime No.447/2024 of Nadakkavu Police Station.
The above case is registered against the petitioner alleging offence punishable under Section 420 of the IPC.

3. When this bail application came up for consideration on 22.10.2024, this Court passed the following order:
"The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that he has handed over a Demand Draft drawn in favour of the additional 2 nd respondent towards the full and final settlement of claim amount in the present case.
The learned counsel appearing for the 2nd respondent acknowledges the receipt of the Demand Draft from the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner.
The 2nd respondent shall execute an affidavit acknowledging receipt of the Demand Draft, after it is 2025:KER:10797 collected.

2. Taking into account the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case, and the fact that the petitioner has paid the entire amount to the 2 nd respondent, I am of the view that the petitioner has made out a prima facie case for an interim order.

3. Hence, I direct, in the event the Investigating Officer arresting the petitioner in Crime No.447/2024 of Nadakkavu Police Station, Kozhikode, he shall enlarge the petitioner on bail, on him executing a bond for Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees One Lakh only)
with two solvent sureties to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer.
From the above it is clear that the matter is settled.
If that be the case, the order dated 22.10.2024 can be made absolute.
